name: @map-harness/spatial-statistics
description: P2 spatial statistics and spatiotemporal patterns: the versioned StatisticSpec/PatternSpec method contracts (observation units, field/denominator, weight matrix, standardization, island handling, permutation count/seed, multiple testing, time windows, missing-data rules, forward holdout), zonal summaries, global/local Moran's I and Getis-Ord Gi* with seeded permutation tests, change/cluster/flow patterns with time-forward and spatial-block stability, and the evidence-lineage/multi-scale/legend projections that keep statistics, legends, and evidence on one version
